title: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
abstract: arXiv:2611.08453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under a frozen teacher's per-token supervision. Does this dense signal reduce the training FLOPs needed to reach a target accuracy compared with reinforcement learning? We systematically compare vanilla reverse-KL OPD with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across task difficulty, student and teacher size, domain, and optimization choices, measuring held-out accuracy against training FLOPs. With an external post-trained teacher, OPD generally loses to GRPO in accuracy per training FLOP at matched settings, even when the teacher is further trained with GRPO, and often suffers response-length inflation. Yet a different teacher changes the picture: when the teacher is the student's own GRPO checkpoint, OPD recovers that checkpoint's accuracy on math with $50\times$ fewer distillation FLOPs than GRPO needs to reach the same accuracy. Following the same teacher setting

translated_title: 解析强到弱在线策略蒸馏（OPD）相对于GRPO的计算效率
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（On-policy distillation，OPD）在冻结教师模型的逐token监督下，基于学生模型自身的rollout进行训练。与强化学习相比，这种密集信号能否减少达到目标准确率所需的训练FLOPs？我们在任务难度、学生与教师模型规模、领域以及优化选择等多个维度上，系统性地比较了原始的反向KL OPD与群体相对策略优化（GRPO），以训练FLOPs为衡量基准评估留出集准确率。结果表明，当使用外部后训练的教师模型时，在匹配设置下，OPD在每单位训练FLOP所能达到的准确率上通常逊色于GRPO，即使教师模型是经过GRPO进一步训练的，且OPD经常出现回复长度膨胀的问题。然而，换一种教师模型会改变这一图景：当教师模型是学生自身经GRPO训练得到的检查点时，OPD在数学任务上能够恢复该检查点的准确率，所需的蒸馏FLOPs比GRPO达到相同准确率所需的少50倍。遵循相同的教师设置
tldr: 本研究系统对比了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）与GRPO的计算效率，发现使用外部教师时OPD效率不如GRPO，但当教师是学生自身的GRPO检查点时，OPD仅需少50倍的FLOPs即可达到相同的数学准确率。
en_tdlr: This work systematically compares the compute efficiency of on-policy distillation (OPD) against GRPO, showing that while OPD underperforms GRPO with an external teacher, it can recover a student's own GRPO checkpoint accuracy on math with 50× fewer FLOPs when that checkpoint serves as the teacher.
